desc:
🦴 Every hit is real! Dummies react exactly where you hit them: shoot a leg and they limp or crawl, hit an arm and they clutch the wound, bonk the head and they faint, then slowly get back up.

💥 REAL RAGDOLL PHYSICS
• Bones crack, fracture and shatter, limbs come off
• Wounds leak purple goo, lose too much and they pass out
• Dummies run away, or get ANGRY and fight back

🔫 25+ WEAPONS
• Bat, Spear, Katana, Chainsaw, Shotgun, Minigun, Bazooka and more
• Laser Eyes, Black Hole and Nukes

🏗️ DEADLY PLAYGROUND
• Rocket pad, drop tower, giant toilet, wood chipper, press, saws, spike pit, cannon
• Drive a tank, a stunt car or an attack helicopter
• Slow-mo, low gravity and fast mode

👥 Play solo or bring friends for a Bones boost
⚡ ADMIN ABUSE and NEW UPDATE events on Saturdays
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new updates!
